set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- if (payload is Object) payload else read(payload as String, 'application/json')]

logger.doc:name: Record decision persistence outcome
logger.message: #['PERSISTED eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' corrId=' ++ vars.corrId ++ ' outcome=' ++ vars.persistResult.outcome]

try.doc:name: Mirror durable throttle window in Object Store

db:select.doc:name: Read durable throttle window
db:select.db:sql: SELECT window_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',window_end) AS window_epoch,masked_card FROM alert_card_windows WHERE card_token=:cardToken

logger.message: #['THROTTLE_CACHE_UNAVAILABLE eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' corrId=' ++ vars.corrId ++ ' durable SQL state retained']
